scripts.compile: npm run build:core && npm run build:node-cli && npm run build:vscode && npm run build:codex && npm run build:claude
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @ai-marketplace/core && npm run lint -w @ai-marketplace/node-cli && npm run lint -w ai-marketplace && npm run lint -w @ai-marketplace/codex-plugin && npm run lint -w @ai-marketplace/claude-plugin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ai-marketplace/core && npm run test -w @ai-marketplace/node-cli && npm run test -w ai-marketplace && npm run test -w @ai-marketplace/codex-plugin && npm run test -w @ai-marketplace/claude-plugin
scripts.validate:plugin: npm run build:codex && npm run validate -w @ai-marketplace/codex-plugin
scripts.validate:claude-plugin: npm run build:claude && npm run validate -w @ai-marketplace/claude-plugin && npm exec -- claude plugin validate ./plugins/ai-marketplace-claude --strict && npm exec -- claude plugin validate . --strict
scripts.package: npm run package:vscode && npm run package:codex && npm run package:claude
